# Pakistan Plastic Works

> Pakistan Plastic Works is a Lahore-based manufacturer of aftermarket plastic replacement parts for Suzuki vehicles, established in early 2010. The company specializes in blow molding and small injection molding (up to 50 grams per piece), hand injection molding, and pipe cutting, and also accepts outsourced manufacturing and labour-based production work.

Factory address: 87/E Grain Market, Near General Bus Stand, Badami Bagh, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/PakistanPlasticWorks
Email: info@pakistanplasticworks.com
Phone / WhatsApp: 0323 4121213

Pakistan Plastic Works is not an authorized Suzuki dealer and is not officially affiliated with Suzuki Motor Corporation; it manufactures aftermarket replacement parts.
